value.answer: Call 911 now. A child who is very drowsy and not responding well after a seizure with fever needs emergency care right away. While you wait, lay them on their side, put nothing in their mouth, do not hold them down, and note what time it started.
value.triage: Call 911 now - do not wait to see if they improve. 811 is not the right line for this, so do not call it first. Tell the dispatcher: seizure, fever, now very drowsy and not responding well.
